paper.authors: S.D.O. Turner and D.A. Romero and P.Y. Zhang and C.H. Amon and T.C.Y. Chan
paper.title: A New Mathematical Programming Approach to Optimize Wind Farm Layouts

scope.claim_boundary: academic equation-level reconstruction of the mathematical-programming framework; not CPLEX, author code, exact Figure-5 data, numerical replay, or an optimality claim after node-limit exhaustion

constraints_and_repair.resolution: exactly K occupied cells; binary y and linearized x constraints; one-cell neighboring local search remains feasible

decision_variables.resolution: 100 binary grid-location variables with fixed cardinality K

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: sorted occupied-index set with explicitly verified x_ij=y_i*y_j MILP linearization

initialization.resolution: 4096 counter-keyed feasible multistarts followed by deterministic local improvement provide the initial incumbent

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: objective, expected power, lower bound, gap, certificate, nodes and timing for one run per native case

objective_and_direction.resolution: minimize composite kinetic-energy interaction while reporting expected power from the original nonlinear wake equation

paper_native_cases.resolution: Cases A/B/C for K=(26,30), (19,39) and (15,39), respectively

parameters.resolution: 10x10 grid, 200 m cell, r0=20 m, hub=60 m, Ct=0.88, alpha=0.1, 4096 multistarts and 200000-node cap

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: fixed 200000 explored-node limit; exactness claimed only after frontier exhaustion; local candidate evaluations separately counted

update_order.resolution: form interaction matrix, construct incumbent, expand best-bound frontier, apply one-cell local search, evaluate nonlinear power

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: Jensen center-in-wake deficit, root-sum-square multiple wakes and P=sum(0.3*v_i^3)
